explication: Echo is an Android music player whose content and playback capabilities are supplied by extensions; the README emphasizes that the app hosts no content. The principal workflow is extension-backed discovery and search, followed by selecting media for playback, with downloads and library management as supporting capabilities. The graph preserves these domain areas and the playback/download internals visible in the source index. Several UI and extension subsystems are represented from the tree and documented interfaces; their internal links are omitted where sampled source does not establish them.
